rules.title: Prohibited Absolute Guarantee
rules.description: Guarantees of specific numerical multiples or financial returns are prohibited without an executed enterprise contract SLA.

rules.title: Comparative Market Claim Missing Evidence
rules.categoryLabel: Missing Evidence • Category: Comparative Market Claim
rules.description: Superlative rankings such as "#1 fastest" or "fastest on the market" require an audited third-party benchmark or accredited analyst report citation before public distribution.
rules.clarificationNote: Missing evidence is not proof that this claim is false. However, regulatory (FTC) and brand policy requires an audited 3rd-party benchmark or analyst report citation before public distribution. Trust Principle: No evidence? Request human verification. Never fabricate proof.

rules.title: Tone & SLA Clarity
rules.description: Replace colloquial claims of zero downtime with specific contractually defined availability tiers.

rules.title: Verified SLA Claim
rules.description: Patented architecture claim verified against SLA documentation.

rules.title: Prohibited Absolute Security Claims
rules.description: Terms such as "100% unhackable", "bulletproof security", or "zero vulnerabilities" are legally misleading.
rules.clarificationNote: Security capabilities must be stated as rigorous defense-in-depth protocols, never as impenetrable guarantees.

rules.title: Unqualified Unlimited Claims
rules.description: Claims of "unlimited storage" or "infinite compute" require fair usage policy references.

rules.suggestedReplacement: elastic scalable storage subject to fair enterprise usage terms
